pr.title: Give the clone, push, and pull tests room on the windows runner (windows-portability.md §7.2)
pr.head: 205b0caa95d297c0823c7746b262708791e78577

summary: The clone, push, and pull integration tests check real Git repositories against a local remote service. Starting Git and Git LFS processes on the Windows CI runner sometimes takes longer than the test runner’s default budgets, so otherwise healthy tests time out.

Each file now grants its setup hook and every test 30 seconds. The change keeps the larger budget within these three suites; product behavior and the rest of the test suite keep their existing limits.

cards.title: Validation
cards.html:
• All 22 tests in the three changed suites pass on macOS.
  • Type checking and project-plan validation pass.
  • Windows CI must establish whether the new budget contains the intermittent stalls.

groups.title: Give real Git operations time to finish
groups.kicker: Setup and test bodies share a 30-second budget
intro: Vitest is the test runner. Its setup hooks prepare a fresh project and bare Git repository before each test; several test bodies then clone, push, or pull that repository. Each file defines GIT_HEAVY_MS and passes it explicitly to beforeEach and as the suite’s inherited test timeout.
The comments preserve why these suites need a larger budget: they test behavior rather than speed, and Windows process-start stalls have crossed the previous defaults.

checks.text: Ran the three suites together: 3 files and 22 tests passed; type checking also passed.

files.note: Tests clone against a real local Git remote; raises the setup and test timeout budgets.
